Thank you for being an Early Access player!

Ravenswatch has left Early Access and is now entering a new era with version 1.0.

This Early Access has been extremely beneficial for the game, but also the studio. As a 'Thank You' for your support during this year and a half of development, Passtech Games and Nacon have unlocked the "Fairytales Skin Pack" bonus in your Steam Account.

Those exclusive skins are available on Scarlet, The Pied Piper, Beowulf and Snow Queen in the heroes' pages.

Ravenswatch's Early Access is: 
• Over 600 000 players
• 5 Major Updates
• A ton of patches and hotfixes!
• Almost 10 million runs played
• And all this thanks to you!

We hope you'll enjoy this new adventure for Ravenswatch, and we cannot wait to share our next plans for the future of the game!

Thieves are coming to the land of Reverie in Ravenswatch's latest free update! Find out more about the new content in the full patch notes.
Read the full patch note here:

IT'S AN AMBUSH!

This new free update to Ravenswatch is shaking up the world of Reverie with the arrival of the Thieves and their formidable stashes. What could they be hiding in their treasure rooms filled with deadly traps? Complete the various Melodies to become even stronger, but watch out for any sticky fingers after your Dream Shards!

Multiplayer pause has also been added, along with a new Mercenaries Skin Pack.

Learn more about the new content in the official trailer and the full patch note.
